name: Accordion · itinerary
description: Day-by-day trip itinerary on a warm gradient.

items.question: Day 1 · Arrive in Lisbon
items.answer: Airport transfer, check in and an evening walk through Alfama ending with a fado dinner.

items.question: Day 2 · Old town and Belem
items.answer: Ride tram 28, taste pasteis de nata at the source and visit the monastery of Jeronimos.

items.question: Day 3 · Sintra
items.answer: Palaces and gardens in the hills with a private driver and a long lunch.

items.question: Day 4 · Train to Porto
items.answer: A scenic morning train followed by free time along the Ribeira.

items.question: Day 5 · Douro Valley
items.answer: River cruise, a vineyard lunch and a tasting at a family-owned quinta.

items.question: Day 6 · Departure
items.answer: Slow breakfast, then a transfer to the airport.
